title_shell.scope: Actual Menu scene and inherited production controller, clock and confirmation UI. Minimal fake locale/profile and external command counters; only process quit is overridden. Headless geometry/input checks, no production autoloads, user persistence or GPU proof.

restart_regression.scope: Two distinct actual production processes with shared isolated user storage: create and save a run, then cold title Log in resumes it. Original main scene and autoloads plus first observer; headless control activation, no physical-input/GPU proof.

backup_regression.scope: Real Backup/shared-shell scenes with fake external operation owners. Headless layout and interaction; no configured game autoloads, user persistence, real backup transactions or GPU raster proof.

routine_clock.scope: Actual RoutineClock Label, one-shot Timer, Source Sans font; injected deterministic time reader, no autoloads or player storage.

verified_behavior: Persistent title strip shows routine local HH:MM; unhosted Return and heading are absent.
One-shot timer aligns to minute boundaries, suspends background reads, refreshes on foreground return and replaces invalid values with localized unavailability.
Clock uses tabular digits, shared text-scale settings, no focus/hit target or live announcements, and owns no gameplay/persistence state.
Ledger Up/Down clamps without wrapping; Tab follows its declared cycle, and visible Return bridges to hosted content.
Backup-to-Settings switches Return focus paths to visible Settings controls; Close/reopen/Return preserve profile state and restore invoking focus.
Shut down uses neutral shared confirmation, no Warning node/edge, Cancel-first and one-level Escape; explicit acceptance calls existing quit seam.
Real production startup and cross-process title resume still restore money5/day1 and usable Backup; default Backup Warning sheets pass their full UI regression.
limits: Headless input/layout and component evidence, not physical-device, assistive-technology or GPU certification.
Positive quit is intercepted only in the focused fixture; actual production shutdown cancellation is verified in both real startup processes.
Existing inherited shutdown diagnostics remain under exact observer-free baseline comparison; no leak-free shutdown claim.
Dark entitlement, optional title art, New Acc replacement policy, full Gallery hosting, legacy Settings internal layout/reset dialogs, and full palette matte remain outside this goal.
All changes remain uncommitted in the isolated worktree; actual player saves, refs, Beads, historical UI00R recovery and unrelated worktrees were not changed.
